disposition: fire at apartments, multiple companies responding
summary: Fire crews were dispatched to an apartment complex in the Fremont Street area on the south end of the street, with multiple engines and a battalion chief responding to what was reported as a fire at the location.

area: Golden State Avenue corridor, north Bakersfield
disposition: subjects taken into custody after perimeter search
summary: Officers with helicopter support chased subjects who fled on foot across a property near Golden State Avenue, setting up a perimeter and clearing buildings before taking them into custody. Air 1 briefly lost sight of the runners in trees before the ground team re-established contact.
A foot chase through residential yards near Decatur Avenue ended when officers contained the suspect between two fenced properties and took him into custody after a brief search.

area: Highway 99, just north of 7th Standard Road
disposition: fire on the freeway, crews responding
summary: Fire crews were sent to a reported fire on Highway 99 just north of 7th Standard Road in the south county.

disposition: downed power poles and lines; vehicle abandoned
summary: A vehicle left the roadway and struck a power pole in a vineyard off King Street, shearing the pole and bringing down power lines. The car was found empty with no one inside, and utility crews were notified.

area: alley off Pacheco Road, south Bakersfield
summary: A person reported to be armed with a knife was located in an alley area off Pacheco Road. The weapon was found and the subject was taken into custody.

area: railroad tracks and riverbed east of Golden State Avenue
disposition: fire knocked down on both sides of the tracks
summary: A vegetation fire broke out along the railroad tracks and riverbed just east of Golden State Avenue, burning on both sides of the tracks and requiring multiple engines, a patrol and a battalion chief. Crews accessed the blaze via a bike path off Chester Avenue to knock it down.

disposition: rollover into power pole; lines compromised
summary: A vehicle rolled onto its roof and crashed into a power pole along Edison Highway just west of the main stretch near the Weedpatch area, leaving the pole leaning and lines down. Utility crews were called as officers investigated the crash.

disposition: driver fled after claiming to have a firearm
summary: A possible intoxicated driver fled a location in the 18th Street area after claiming to have a firearm, last seen southbound in a dark Audi. Officers broadcast a lookout for the vehicle.
